goals.text: Complete 1 TinaCMS v4 PBI - four v4 PBIs closed: Plugin System Media Backend for TinaCloud (tinacms#6886), the Media Manager screen (tinacms#6891), Plugin System Auth (tinacms#7689) and Field-Level Validation Errors (tinacms#7681), taking Plugin-Based Architecture to 8/15 and Forms System Rebuild to 6/8

Complete 1 WorkOS Migration PBI - the Cognito to WorkOS account migration export, scan and account rules closed (tinacloud#4138), while deciding how GitHub accounts migrate (tinacloud#4393) is still in progress

sections.heading: 4. Application Health
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-127/health.png)

Application Health Dashboard Overview. Identity API HTTP 500s dropped from 93 to 14. Content API HTTP 500s dropped from 1.7k to 180 - [TinaCloud CloudWatch Dashboard](https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=us-east-1#dashboards/dashboard/tinacloud-overview)

sections.heading: 5. TinaCloud PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-127/commits.png)

Total Commits processed by TinaCloud over the last 6 months, total commits (aka spits) over the last month was 41,100 (up 17% on the previous period) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-127/onboarding.png)

User onboarding over the last 7 days - New accounts were 10% last Sprint and are now 7% (10 of 140). Invited collaborators were 22% and are now 20% (23 of 113) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-127/projects.png)

Organisation and project creation over the last 7 days - 141 new organisations, up from 139 last Sprint - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

sections.heading: 6. TinaCMS PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-127/dau.png)

Daily active users this month - peaking at 705 on 29 Sep, and at 674 on 6 Oct this Sprint (dips are weekends) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

![](/uploads/sprint-127/geo.png)

Distribution of unique TinaCMS users over the last 30 days - US is our top country with 1,681 users, up 90 on the prior 30 days, ahead of Germany on 599 and the UK on 480 - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)
